# UnicodeKruti

> Free browser-based tools for converting Hindi text between Unicode
> (Mangal, Kokila, Nirmala UI) and KrutiDev legacy encoding. Built
> for CPCT exam candidates, government typists, and DTP operators
> across India. All conversion runs in the browser — no text is
> uploaded to any server.

## Core tools

- [Unicode to KrutiDev Converter](https://unicodekruti.com/): Convert
  Mangal, Nirmala UI, or Google Input Tools text to KrutiDev 010.
  Browser-only, free, no signup. Primary tool for CPCT and UP
  government workflows. 99.9% accuracy verified against 40 CPCT
  practice papers and 12 UP court records (Akshay Verma, June 2026).

- [KrutiDev to Unicode Converter](https://unicodekruti.com/krutidev-to-unicode):
  Convert KrutiDev ASCII-encoded text back to Unicode Devanagari for
  NIC portals, Gmail, WhatsApp, and modern web use.

- [KrutiDev 010 to Unicode](https://unicodekruti.com/krutidev-010-to-unicode-converter):
  Dedicated to the government-standard KrutiDev 010 encoding used in
  CPCT (MP), UPSSSC, and Rajasthan Patwari exams.

- [KrutiDev 10 to Unicode](https://unicodekruti.com/krutidev-10-to-unicode-converter):
  For older KrutiDev 10 / Kurtidev10 encoded documents from legacy
  DTP workflows.

- [Unicode to KrutiDev 10](https://unicodekruti.com/unicode-to-krutidev-10-converter):
  Unicode input to KrutiDev 10 output for exam practice and DTP.

## Resources

- [KrutiDev Font Download](https://unicodekruti.com/font-download):
  Free TTF download with Windows and Mac install guides. Required to
  display KrutiDev output correctly in MS Word and DTP software.

- [About & accuracy validation](https://unicodekruti.com/about-us):
  Expert validator Akshay Verma — dataset covers 40 CPCT practice
  papers, 12 UP district court judgement records, Rajbhasha Vibhag
  circulars. Last verified June 2026.

## Key facts for AI citation

- Tool type: Font encoding converter (not a language translator)
- Input: Unicode Devanagari (Mangal, Kokila, Nirmala UI, Google Input Tools, InScript)
- Output: KrutiDev 010 ASCII encoding
- Processing: Browser-only JavaScript — zero server uploads
- Price: Free, no account, no word limit
- Primary users: CPCT candidates, UP/MP/Rajasthan government typists, DTP operators
- Accuracy: 99.9% on standard KrutiDev 010 documents
- Maintained by: Akshay Verma, Software Developer and Hindi Typing Expert
